text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to business, I was traveling on the Shinkansen.
Being a weekday afternoon, passengers were sparse.
In that very carriage—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! My—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, you were on this train too, were you?
Are your retainers not with you today?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When traveling,
tranquility is paramount, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
However, it has become somewhat dull.
You there, entertain us.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
We care not what manner of amusement it may be.
—Come.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Will someone like me suffice?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Whaaaaaaaaattttt?! M-Me?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Oh no, this is an incredible honor, but my taste is about to be put to the ultimate test...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (F-First, let's start with a classic and feel things out from there... right?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: How about watching a movie on your phone? Do you watch movies often?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Mm. I indulge occasionally.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Alright! We're getting somewhere! Let's keep rolling with this!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Then how about an action movie? The recent blockbuster that was trending was quite thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Hmph... That does not particularly strike my fancy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (N-No good...?! What should I do?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Comedy—definitely won't do, right?! Horror, then? Sci-fi? ...I have no idea!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (What works here?! What's the right answer?!)

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. For now, something that allows me to pass the time at a leisurely pace would suffice.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (—!! A hint!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (A movie to pass the time leisurely—ah!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —In that case, there's a film that truly moved me recently.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's a story about a painter—at first, the painter struggled because none of their paintings would sell.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yet, they held absolute confidence in their artistic sense. Believing they were superior to all and would never yield.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: So, through decades of relentless effort... in the end, they were finally recognized as a magnificent artist.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Oho— Very well. Play it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Right away!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I will set it up for you immediately. Please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (............This won't do. I'm so anxious about how it's going that I can't focus on anything...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I wonder... is Orfe-san enjoying it...? *Sigh*...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two hours later—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work during the trip. How was—the movie?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: It served adequately to kill the time. I commend your effort.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: My, really? I am truly glad that it pleased you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Thank goodness...! Watching that for my own cultural refinement really paid off~...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon stepping off the train onto the platform, Lucky Lilac and Orfèvre were chatting pleasantly.
